Remove repeated cumulative fractions

Source: R/germination.R
clean_germ_data.Rd

Keeps only the first observation of each cumulative fraction within a germination curve, dropping later points where germination did not increase. This is the "cleaned" data option of the PBTM app.

Usage

clean_germ_data(data, groups = "TrtID")

Arguments

data

A data frame with CumTime and CumFraction columns.

groups

Columns identifying each germination curve.

Value

data without the repeated observations.

See also

Other germination data helpers: calc_cum_frac(), germ_speed(), pbtm_columns, plot_germ_data(), rescale_cum_frac(), validate_germ_data()

Examples

nrow(thermal_time_data)
#> [1] 100
nrow(clean_germ_data(thermal_time_data))
#> [1] 100
